name: Dynamic Asteroids: Extreme Edition 2.0 (Cyclone)
author: keltuze
description: Extreme Edition 2.0.1: Living asteroid belts (100–1000 rocks stream) with endless planetary ring avalanche, omnidirectional 360 cyclones & anticyclones, multi-angle converging swarms, and 5% targeted sniper torrents against ships! Features zero lag (120 FPS), sparkling kinetic trails, and live hotkeys [/] and [Shift +/-] in simulation.
